title: EXPRES: A Next Generation RV Spectrograph in the Search for Earth-like Worlds
what_was_studied: Error budget, optomechanical design, environmental control, image stabilization and calibration
numerical_result: 15 cm/s instrument design target; better than 30 cm/s intended on-sky precision
remaining_question: A design target is not achieved long-term stellar precision

title: Towards a Self-calibrating Empirical Light-Weight Model for Tellurics in High-Resolution Spectra
what_was_studied: SELENITE empirical telluric identification and fitting
numerical_result: 1.0% continuum residuals for B stars and 1.1% for K dwarfs in the reported tests
remaining_question: Residual telluric structure must be translated into wavelength-dependent RV impact

title: Performance Verification of the EXtreme PREcision Spectrograph
what_was_studied: Laboratory and on-sky tests of calibration, illumination, detector and observing subsystems
numerical_result: Better than 10 cm/s single-measurement instrument calibration precision in the stated test
remaining_question: The number excludes photon noise and stellar variability and is not an end-to-end stellar floor

title: An Extreme-Precision Radial-Velocity Pipeline: First Radial Velocities from EXPRES
what_was_studied: Flat-relative extraction, chromatic barycentric correction, calibration offsets and template matching
numerical_result: 0.3 m/s formal error at per-pixel S/N 250; 0.895 m/s residual RMS for 51 Peg
remaining_question: Commissioning-target residuals mix instrument star sampling and model choices

title: EXPRES I. HD 3651 an Ideal RV Benchmark
what_was_studied: Recovery of the known 62-day Saturn-mass planet with high-cadence EXPRES observations
numerical_result: 58 cm/s residual RMS over roughly six months
remaining_question: A quiet benchmark over six months does not establish multi-year stability for all targets

title: The EXPRES Stellar-Signals Project I. Description of Data
what_was_studied: Common spectroscopic, radial-velocity, activity-indicator and photometric data for four stars
numerical_result: Four named stellar data sets released for method comparison
remaining_question: The note defines a comparison resource rather than selecting a winning activity model

title: High-resolution Transmission Spectroscopy of MASCARA-2 b with EXPRES
what_was_studied: Cross-correlation transmission spectroscopy with early EXPRES transit observations
numerical_result: Fe I Fe II Na I Mg I and Cr II reported; projected obliquity 1.6 plus or minus 3.1 degrees
remaining_question: Atmospheric cross-correlation detections do not measure long-term Doppler stability

title: Excalibur: A Non-Parametric Hierarchical Wavelength-Calibration Method for a Precision Spectrograph
what_was_studied: Low-dimensional non-parametric modelling of laser-frequency-comb wavelength solutions
numerical_result: Calibration residual RMS about five times lower; HD 34411 RMS changed from 1.17 to 1.05 m/s in the reported comparison
remaining_question: The modest stellar-RMS change shows that calibration is only one term in the full error budget

title: The EXPRES Stellar Signals Project II. State of the Field in Disentangling Photospheric Velocities
what_was_studied: Twenty-two stellar-activity mitigation methods applied to common EXPRES data
numerical_result: Nearly all improved on classic linear decorrelation; none consistently produced sub-m/s RMS
remaining_question: Unknown ground truth and disagreement between methods require signal-preservation tests

title: The Extreme Stellar-Signals Project III. Combining Solar Data from HARPS HARPS-N EXPRES and NEID
what_was_studied: Simultaneous Sun-as-a-star velocities from four stabilized spectrographs
numerical_result: 15 to 30 cm/s residual intra-day inter-instrument scatter
remaining_question: Intra-day agreement does not by itself establish multi-year absolute accuracy

title: Quiet Please: Detrending Radial Velocity Variations from Stellar Activity with a Physically Motivated Spot Model
what_was_studied: Rotation-Convection model tested with solar and HD 26965 observations including EXPRES
numerical_result: Activity was reduced to the m/s level for HD 26965 across HARPS EXPRES and NEID
remaining_question: Planet preservation and transfer to stars with different activity patterns remain to be established

title: Uncovering Hidden Systematics in Extreme-Precision Radial Velocity Measurements
what_was_studied: Seven years of EXPRES data, two-dimensional echellogram diagnostics, comb-line shapes and telemetry
numerical_result: 2.8 m/s trough-to-peak drift; solar trend RMS 1.32 to 0.43 m/s; 26% lower scatter across 12 quiet stars
remaining_question: Corrections need era-aware out-of-sample validation and explicit planet-signal preservation checks

title: A linearized approach to radial-velocity extraction II: shot-noise-limited precision via spectral factorization
what_was_studied: Short-time Fourier factorization tested on simulations and EXPRES HD 34411 and tau Ceti spectra
numerical_result: Approximately 30 cm/s instrumental precision and sensitivity to about 50 cm/s semi-amplitudes in the reported tests
remaining_question: The method returns relative velocities and requires broader independent validation
